newsitem.title: USA: Network says will buy Eastern Telecom Int'l.
newsitem.headline: Network says will buy Eastern Telecom Int'l.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc said Monday it has reached an agreement to merge with Eastern Telecom International Corp, a privately held company from Newport News, Va.
Network said terms of the deal include the consideration of about 3.6 million shares of Network common stock, $1.5 million in cash, and the assumption of $1.2 million in long term debt.

The company said John Crawford and Thomas Keefe, Eastern's chief executive officer and chief financial officer, will join Network once the deal is closed as chairman of the board of directors and chief financial officer, respectively.
Network said the deal will be accounted for as a purchase, and is expected to close in the second calendar quarter of 1997.
Network said Eastern Telecom's revenues for the fiscal year ended April 30, 1996 were $16.12 million.
Network said it has scheduled an investors' conference call about the deal for Monday at 1130 EDT/1530 GMT.
The company said the phone number for the teleconference is 1-800-966-1573.
The company said overseas investors should call 1-214-824-1553.
